I answered Marcus in the thread under his message in #north-team. I didn't give him one date, because the records disagree and nothing I found settles it.

- **25 November:** Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct. I just noted it back to her then without checking it.
- **30 Nov 2026:** This is the end of the current term (the renewal date) in the signed 2025–26 renewal order form. The account profile also says 30 Nov, and Marcus is listed as the account owner.
- **31 Dec 2026:** An older CRM note from February says this, and it matches neither of the others.

I couldn't find anything that moves the date to 25 November. I asked Marcus to wait before updating the account sheet, and asked Ilse in the same thread whether 25 Nov is a newly agreed date or a mistake for 30 Nov.

Marcus is in #north-team, so he could already see Ilse's post. A renewal date is a practical detail about the account, not a money term, so it was fine to share it with him there.
